rule: Pool = all v2_holdout and v2_realfail cases minus the 20 cases of reports/v2_regression_set.json. For each pool case, build the GT graph (inscribed radii, v1 path) and run v1 detect_lesions; score = number of GT lesions with ds >= 0.5. Take the 30 highest scores (ties: more lesions with ds >= 0.7, then lower case id), skipping any case without a first-pass mask (S16 location). Uses GT only: no predictions or model outputs.
